headline: Waist-to-chest SSE, glassy dawn then onshore — early or skip.
today: Decent SSE angle to 2.2ft but short period, and the SSW wind goes onshore by mid-morning. Dawn is the only clean window with light SSW — log or fish it before 8am. After that it's a soft onshore mush.

daysToWatch.note: Prime ESE angle at 3ft with cross-off NE/E wind through the morning — one of the few spots that actually works Saturday. Short period but clean and sizey.
Nearly 3ft on a good SSE angle with N offshore at dawn and light morning wind. Clean and worth the 3hr if you're chasing it.
